title.narrative: Programa de Fortalecimiento de la Actividad Empresarial del Estado de Baha
Strengthening of the Entrepreneurial Activity Program Estado de Baha

description.narrative: El Estado de Bahia ha solicitado un prstamo al Banco con el objetivo de mejorar la competitividad de sus sectores productivos localizados en torno a clusters, que en Brasil son denominados Arranjos Produtivos Locais (APLs). El Programa que se prepara tendr como unidad ejecutora (UE) al gobierno estadual, a travs de la Secretaria de Ciencia, Tecnologa e Innovacin. Adicional a la UE, la Federacin de Industrias de Bahia (FIEB) y el Servicio Brasileo de Apoyo a las Micro y Pequeas Empresas (SEBRAE), acompaarn la ejecucin. Este ltimo es responsable de la contraparte financiera local.

The state of Bahia has requested a loan to the Bank in order to improve the competitiveness of productive sectors that present a territorial concentration of their economic activity. The Program's executing agency (EU) is the Government of Bahia, through the Science, Technology and Innovation Department. In addition to the EU, the Federacin de Industrias de Bahia (FIEB) and the Servicio Brasileo de Apoyo a las Micro y Pequeas Empresas (SEBRAE), will participate in the execution. The components of the Program are: (i) mobilization and articulation of the entrepreneurial demand; (ii) strengthening of entrepreneurial support services supply to clusters in Bahia; (iii) direct support actions to strengthen the competitiveness of selected clusters; (iv) administration of the program, monitoring, dissemination of results and lessons learnt.
